workflow_instructions.mode_overview: This mode gives an existing BAW process app a React + Carbon UI without touching its logic. You analyze each legacy coach, design a better screen, and write it as a React component. For every client-side human service, the baw-dev-tools MCP server adds copies named "(Modernized)" (brand theme) and "(Modernized - Carbon)" (carbon theme) whose coaches show your screens. The original buttons stay in each coach, hidden, and your screen presses them, so the coach flow and its scripts run unchanged. The legacy services stay next to the copies.

step.details: Ask for the process app acronym when it is not given; list_apps and list_snapshots help. Modernized copies install as a new snapshot of a ZZ app only. When the source is not a ZZ app, say so and ask the user how to proceed.

steps.step: export_app, inspect_coaches; test_service on the legacy service to see the screens as users do today
Improve the spec: human labels, section titles, required fields, patterns, examples, read-only review coaches
STOP unless told to continue: show what is wrong with the legacy screens, your design for each coach, and the spec changes
Write one screen per coach in react-coach/src/screens/, set "screen" on each coach, build_screens
modernize_app with a new snapshot, install_app
test_service for every modernized service with fill; look at the screenshots, fix and repeat until right
Report each service with its result, the screens written, and before / after screenshots

completion_criteria.criterion: Every service marked "modernize": true has two modernized copies installed
test_service reports "ok": true for every copy, and you have looked at the screenshots
The report lists the services, the snapshot, the screens written, screenshot folders, and what the spec kept native or dropped
